CONTEXT. `export TMPDIR=/tmp PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge:/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/packages/worldkeeper/src && /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/scripts/branch_report.py <incident id>` prints the branch report for an incident (the real one for scene 2C is `i_2c_rebecca_corridor`). A recent change made facts that the incident scene's own exit transition reads count as "read", which is right for the "read by:" wording. But the final comparison line "Branches that leave no trace in any later scene:" now uses the same notion, so a branch whose only reader is the exit transition (which belongs to the incident's own scene, not a later scene) wrongly counts as having left a trace. On the real 2C incident that line used to list the transmit branch, the recovery branch and the missed-window branch, and now lists only the missed-window branch.

FIX. A branch leaves a trace in a later scene only if at least one fact it sets (or one declared advantage or cost it sets) is read by a record whose scene is the NEXT scene or any scene after it (Consumer.scene_id, compared with the incident's scene and the next scene's id; a consumer with scene_id equal to the incident's own scene, and the exit transition itself, do not count). Keep the per-fact "read by:" wording as it is. Make the two ideas separate in the code: one helper for "read by anything, including this scene's exit transition" and one for "read in a later scene". If the order of scenes is needed, derive it from the package's scene list order or the pacing transitions graph; do not hard-code ids. Expected on the real 2C incident: the line lists the transmit branch, the recovery branch (`SL-2C-E`) and the missed-window branch (`purge_window_2c`), and does NOT list the rescue branch.

FORMAT FIX. In "Handoff analysis" the two headings "Carried over from the branch:" and "Appears with the next scene:" are bare lines between list items. Render them as list items with nested bullets beneath, matching the style of the "Entry variants that apply" block, and put a blank line before the "Handoff from ..." line.

ADD TESTS in /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_branch_report.py: the real 2C incident's report names exactly those three branches in the no-trace line and not the rescue branch (pin by id in the test only); a seeded copy where a branch's only reader is the exit transition still counts as leaving no trace; a seeded copy where the next scene gains an entry variant requiring a fact that branch sets makes the branch leave a trace. Existing tests must keep passing.

HOW TO RUN (from /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge): `export TMPDIR=/tmp PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge:/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/packages/worldkeeper/src && /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_branch_report.py /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_gap_rules.py /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_impact_report.py /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_situation_trace.py -q --no-cov -p no:cacheprovider 2>&1 | tail -20`. Format and lint: `/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/storygame/story_package/branch_report.py /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_branch_report.py && /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/storygame/story_package/branch_report.py /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_branch_report.py` (if ruff format cannot write because the filesystem is read-only, run `ruff format --check` and say so).
